G.definition: `sqrt(1-rho)*qpsk_map(coded,scale=1)`, `sqrt(rho)*zc`, complex unit noise, `sigma2=10**(-snr/10)`, then physical observation.

A1.definition: Unit Rayleigh-amplitude norm; `fix_energy=True` leaves scale=1, without rescaling the truncated virtual-Doppler matrix.

OBS.definition: `a=sqrt(2*(1-rho))`; receiver `y,pilot` divided by a; `sigma2` divided by a²; receiver data energy exactly .5.

PHY.definition: Physical CPP rebuild replaces the preliminary truncated-atom channel; records channel energy; SNR reuse scales only the same noise array.

Q.definition: QPSK `(±1±j)/sqrt(2)`, I bits followed by Q bits; unscaled symbol energy 1. No Eb/N0 conversion.

CODE.definition: SP n=2048, k=1024, N=1024; frozen generator-matrix SHA256 `bfd42472…aa6af`.

RNG.definition: TCRF entropy/domain + frame + component (channel=1,message=2,noise=3); no rho/SNR/scenario coordinate. Paired fingerprints asserted.

CTX.definition: All later P1 families regenerate the same frame with P1 seeds then reuse it at SNR; `gd.observe` calls OBS.

DET.definition: CE ridge and detector use the passed internal sigma2; native data power `1-system.rho=.5`; F1 explicitly uses .5.

findings.finding: P1 and E3 share a physical SNR/power/noise convention. The receiver coordinate shim scales y and noise together.
P2b is equal nominal total useful-frame energy, not equal Eb. Different data symbol energy/code rate is stated explicitly.
Audit brief phrase Jakes-4 rays per tap is ambiguous: actual and preregistered law is 1+Poisson(3), mean4, not exactly4.
Original P1 gen_fixed source has an exact MD5-matching saved copy; current default-preserving scenario-S extension must be distinguished.

source_identity.reason: Current source adds delay_scale/l_trunc for scenario S; default-preserving static diff only.

limits: Static inspection is not runtime verification.
Unit nominal total energy is not unit realised combined/received energy for every superimposed frame.
P1 U/G share raw exogenous draws; their physical Dopplers and therefore H differ intentionally.
E2 C has independent E2CJ entropy; numeric frame indices do not pair it to P1/R.
P2b SP and EP share channel/noise, but differing codeword dimensions preclude codeword equality.
SBL beta is learned after initialization using the correct known input variance; this is not a generator-noise mismatch.
